engine: to-place.co.jp's scroll BAIT — a small serif 'scroll' label over a faint vertical TRACK with a bright TICK that AUTOPLAYS descending top->bottom (a 'drip down the line' + an empty beat between drips), gated to the FIRST viewport, fading out + swapping to an audio-bars EQ glyph once the user scrolls. Its job is to convince a STATIONARY user (scroll = 0) that the page scrolls — the single most-reusable atom for any dark-ground hero. Harvested from D_toplace_video.md (§2).

measured_teardown.move: THE CRITICAL INVERSION: it AUTOPLAYS at rest (scroll=0). NOT a scrollbar thumb, NOT bound to scroll position (scroll-binding defeats its only purpose — a dead first screen shows no motion). Loop ~1.9s/cycle: the bright tick spawns at the TOP of the track (~22px, quick fade-in to white 255), translates DOWN shortening (~22->8px) + dimming toward the bottom, fades to 0; then an EMPTY BEAT (~0.15s repeatDelay) before the next drip (reads as discrete drips, not a marquee). DOWN only, never yoyo. Soft glow on the tick. LIFETIME = first viewport: an IntersectionObserver on the hero (or a scroll>40 check) fades the label+track 1->0 as the hero leaves and swaps to an audio-bars glyph (the 'now playing' state, reusable on interior video sections).
measured_teardown.cited: to-place hero: bottom-right corner — serif lowercase 'scroll' over a ~1px x ~100px white@12% track, an ultra-bright (255) ~18-25px tick descending it, shortening + dimming, with a reset gap; replaced by a small vertical audio-equalizer glyph once scrolled into the interior video sections.

label.what: the cue word (lowercase serif; keep it one word, not 'scroll down').

tickH.what: tick length at full (top of the track).

tickMin.what: tick length at the bottom (it shortens as it descends).

gap.what: the EMPTY BEAT between drips (load-bearing — keeps it reading as drips, not a loading marquee).

glow.what: soft white box-shadow on the tick (the h-012 glowing node).

gateTo.what: selector|element for the IntersectionObserver (the hero); null = gate on window scroll>40.

swapToBars.what: after the hero leaves, swap the cue to an animated audio-bars EQ glyph.

autoplay.what: start the loop immediately (it must move before any scroll).

entry: ScrollHintDescendingTick.create(target, opts) -> { start, stop, hide, show, el, destroy }. target = the hint container (.shd-hint). The engine BUILDS .shd-label + .shd-track > .shd-tick + .shd-bars > .shd-bar x4 if they're absent. No GSAP required (CSS @keyframes injected); uses a GSAP timeline if gsap is present.
law: transform(translateY, scaleY) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. The loop runs via injected CSS @keyframes OR a GSAP timeline. Contrast IS the effect: ultra-bright tick (#fff 255) on a near-invisible track (~12%) — brighten the track and it competes; dim the tick and it's lost. Gating fades ONLY the label+track (the bars are a sibling that survives the gone-state). reduced-motion -> a single slow pulse (no perpetual loop; battery on mobile). owns_pin false; A-ambient timing layer.
gate_mode: an ambient corner cue (not scroll-driven). Verify: at REST (scroll=0) the tick AUTOPLAYS descending the track with an empty beat between drips (DOWN only); on scroll the label+track fade out and the audio-bars glyph turns on; on scroll back to top the cue returns. Sample the tick's top over time (must move ~>20px) to prove autoplay, and check the gate swap. NOTE: the cue is a tiny bottom-right corner element — crop the corner to screenshot the tick; the bars appear in the same spot after scroll.
proven: lab: a to-place-style charcoal hero (TO PLACE wordmark + diamond, white menu-dot, MORE pill, ghost 'VOICE' wordmark) with the cue bottom-right. AT REST (scroll=0): tick top travels 670->752 (down-only across a cycle) then resets to 630 (next drip from top) = moved 122px -> AUTOPLAYING, not scroll-bound; empty-beat observed (opacity dips <0.08 between drips). GATE: scroll down -> hint opacity 1->0 (shd-gone) + bars is-on=true (audio-bars EQ glyph, 17x22px corner, animating); scroll back to top -> cue returns (opacity 1, active). Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, 4s of the autoplay loop at rest): 241 frames, 0.00% long frames -> PASS (GPU-cheap loop). Screenshots: corner crop = serif 'scroll' + faint track + bright descending tick; scrolled corner = the 4-bar EQ glyph. FIX (this brick): the gone-state must fade ONLY .shd-label+.shd-track, NOT the whole container, else the audio-bars (a child) fade too — restructured so bars survive. Relative: shared/scroll-indicator (a PROGRESS REPORTER bound to scroll position) — this is its exact INVERSION (a rest-state baiter that autoplays at scroll=0). Serif = Playfair Display (Canela-class). Reusable across every dark-ground hero (smarts/quadro/nahirna/towns).
